sv.title: Ex-politiker tar över klubban i drivmedelsjätten
sv.summary: Den tidigare socialdemokratiska ministern Ibrahim Baylan blir ny styrelseordförande i drivmedelsbolaget OKQ8, som har omkring 1.000 mackar i Norden.

en.title: Former politician takes over the chair at fuel giant
en.summary: Former Social Democrat minister Ibrahim Baylan becomes new board chair of fuel company OKQ8, which has about 1,000 stations in the Nordics.
